mapper.select: SELECT t.environment_history_id AS environmentHistoryId, t.plan_id AS planId, t.measured_at AS measuredAt, t.temperature, t.humidity, t.co2, t.radiation, t.light, t.soil_temperature AS soilTemperature, t.soil_moisture AS soilMoisture, t.soil_ec AS soilEc, t.soil_ph AS soilPh FROM greenhouse_environment_history t JOIN cultivation_plan p ON p.plan_id = t.plan_id WHERE p.member_id = #{memberId} AND t.plan_id = #{planId} AND t.environment_history_id = #{environmentHistoryId}

SELECT t.issue_id AS issueId, t.plan_id AS planId, t.issue_type AS issueType, t.issue_message AS issueMessage, t.occurred_at AS occurredAt, t.issue_status AS issueStatus, t.issue_value AS issueValue, t.action_content AS actionContent, t.action_completed_at AS actionCompletedAt FROM greenhouse_issue t JOIN cultivation_plan p ON p.plan_id = t.plan_id WHERE p.member_id = #{memberId} AND t.plan_id = #{planId} AND t.issue_id = #{issueId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO greenhouse_environment_history (plan_id, measured_at, temperature, humidity, co2, radiation, light, soil_temperature, soil_moisture, soil_ec, soil_ph) VALUES (#{planId}, #{measuredAt}, #{temperature}, #{humidity}, #{co2}, #{radiation}, #{light}, #{soilTemperature}, #{soilMoisture}, #{soilEc}, #{soilPh})
INSERT INTO greenhouse_issue (plan_id, issue_type, issue_message, occurred_at, issue_status, issue_value) VALUES (#{planId}, #{issueType}, #{issueMessage}, #{occurredAt}, '발생', #{issueValue})
mapper.select: SELECT environment_history_id AS environmentHistoryId, plan_id AS planId, measured_at AS measuredAt, temperature, humidity, co2, radiation, light, soil_temperature AS soilTemperature, soil_moisture AS soilMoisture, soil_ec AS soilEc, soil_ph AS soilPh FROM greenhouse_environment_history WHERE plan_id = #{planId} AND measured_at = #{measuredAt} ORDER BY environment_history_id LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE greenhouse_issue SET issue_status = '조치중' WHERE issue_id = #{issueId} AND plan_id = #{planId} AND issue_status = '발생'

UPDATE greenhouse_issue SET issue_status = '조치 완료', action_content = #{actionContent}, action_completed_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE issue_id = #{issueId} AND plan_id = #{planId} AND issue_status = '조치중'
UPDATE greenhouse_issue SET action_content = #{actionContent} WHERE issue_id = #{issueId} AND plan_id = #{planId}
